```{r}
docs <- readRDS(here::here("data", "documents.rds"))

n_docs     <- nrow(docs)
n_issuers  <- dplyr::n_distinct(docs$country_name)
year_range <- range(docs$year)
```

The Military Doctrines dataset is a catalog of `r format(n_docs, big.mark = ",")` national security strategies, defense white papers, and related strategy documents issued by `r n_issuers` countries, territories, and organizations from `r year_range[1]` to `r year_range[2]`. The documents are collected from government websites and other online repositories in their original PDF format and converted into machine-readable text and chunked CSV formats. All three versions can be [browsed and downloaded](content/data.qmd); the [codebook](content/codebook.qmd) documents the files and variables, and the [changelog](content/changelog.qmd) records what changed in each release.

The Military Doctrines project is led by [J Andrés Gannon](https://jandresgannon.com/), Assistant Professor of Political Science at [Vanderbilt University](https://as.vanderbilt.edu/political-science/bio/andres-gannon-/).

```{r}
counts <- docs |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(iso3)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(iso3) |>
  dplyr::summarise(country = dplyr::first(country),
                   num_documents = dplyr::n(),
                   first_year = min(year), last_year = max(year),
                   .groups = "drop")

world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  dplyr::select(adm0_a3, name) |>
  dplyr::left_join(counts, by = c("adm0_a3" = "iso3")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    num_documents = dplyr::coalesce(num_documents, 0L),
    label = dplyr::if_else(
      num_documents > 0,
      sprintf("%s: %d documents (%d–%d)", country, num_documents, first_year, last_year),
      sprintf("%s: no documents", name)
    )
  )

bins <- sort(unique(c(0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 40, max(world$num_documents) + 1)))
pal <- leaflet::colorBin("Purples", domain = world$num_documents, bins = bins, right = FALSE)

leaflet::leaflet(world) |>
  leaflet::addTiles() |>
  leaflet::setView(lng = 0, lat = 30, zoom = 2) |>
  leaflet::addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(num_documents),
    weight = 1, opacity = 1, color = "white", dashArray = "3", fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlightOptions = leaflet::highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#666", dashArray = "",
                                                 fillOpacity = 0.7, bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = ~label,
    labelOptions = leaflet::labelOptions(style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
                                         textsize = "15px", direction = "auto")
  ) |>
  leaflet::addLegend(position = "bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~num_documents,
                     title = "Documents", opacity = 0.7,
                     labFormat = leaflet::labelFormat(between = "–"))
```
